scope: Borrowed native clone ownership and Serialize suitability of six BattleCore leaf root families; root owns implementation, testing and acceptance.
frozen_optional_trace: Overflow creates gap only. Optional trace never affects mandatory clone accounting/admission/gameplay/RNG/mandatory receipts.

roots.clone: derived Clone; every direct child is Copy
roots.proposed: native exhaustive struct_shape; fixed child records may use scalar/closed-leaf visitors
native exhaustive struct/enum visitors; reuse reviewed UnitCombatProfile leaf and existing GrowthStack native visitor; stop at resolved boss definition Arc

children.UnitCombatProfile: Already explicit serialized_leaf; stats/basic_attack/basic_attack_speed_percent/weapon_profile/movement/resonance/skill_id/skill_activation_mode/deployment_affinity/block_capacity/block_radius_units/blockable/mobility_kind/target_traits/incoming_damage_modifiers. Owned deep children only SkillId(String), TileRangePattern.rows Vec<String>, Vec<UnitTargetTrait>, and nested fixed delivery/profile records; no metadata Arc/map. Collision.despawn_on_hit has skip_serializing_if=None, no hidden owned allocation.

serde_skipped: No serde representation for root/runtime scenario records. Do not serialize an improvised mirror that drops native table or Arc ownership.

roots.proposed: native exhaustive 21-variant match with explicit all-field patterns, event record admission before children; EventQueue owns BinaryHeap storage and iterates borrowed heap
roots.measurement_warning: Borrowed iter; do not clone/pop/sort/format events for measurement. complete_payload_key formats Debug and can traverse Arc pointees; queue Ord is not clone shape.

roots.proposed: native exhaustive struct_shape; Option<Arc<_>> handle only; Vec<DamageBonusSnapshot> admission before scan; fixed child visitors

children.DamageModifiers: Copy Serialize record of 14 i32 fields (penetration, amplification/reduction, crit); no owned children
children.SkillCastExecutionSource: Arc pointee boundary: skill_id:SkillId(String), caster_instance_id:UnitInstanceId, cast_seq:u64, ability_event_seq:u64, cause:BattleEventCause, proc_origin:Option<SkillProcOrigin>. Do not visit pointee on this clone.

roots.warning: BattleEventLogEntry.skill_effect_source is a different Option<Arc<SkillEffectExecutionSource>> with serde(skip); it requires explicit event-log owner shape, not borrowed log Serialize.

roots.proposed: may add only this concrete enum to serialized_leaf whitelist; no mirrors/formatting
roots.serializer_proof: Internally tagged struct variants without flatten use SerializeStruct in pinned serde_derive 1.0.228 (ser.rs:632-635,885-952). Uuid 1.17.0 uses stack encode_buffer and serialize_str / serialize_bytes, not collect_str; UnitInstanceId transparent wraps Uuid.

roots.proposed: owner-local native shapes for BuffInstanceKey/ActiveBuff; BuffDef if its separate actual clone is metered; do not recurse through GameDataBase
native_tables: BuffDatabase.by_id native HashMap only if cloning DB value itself; not transitive from ActiveBuff
roots.safe_child_leaf: BuffMetadata derives Serialize and has one String plus fixed children; BuffDef itself has no Serialize despite same basic shape plus id.
roots.scope_note: Transient BuffDef clones are separate from whole BattleCore clone; ActiveBuff owns neither a BuffDef nor an Arc.

read_limits: No atomic repository snapshot. Each hash/excerpt is one source read; concurrent root changes captured as separate versions.

followup_obligations: Native EventQueue/Scenario visitors and full preclone outer integration remain root-owned implementation choices.
Transient BuffDef get().cloned() is separate per-operation copy, not ActiveBuff transitive ownership.
Do not expand LeafSerializer to BuffDatabase or any shared compiled definition graph.
Use no fake IDs, panic paths, serialized mirrors or source clones to measure ownership.
